findings.title: Combined error conditions obscure failures
findings.message: read_icon reads the file, then checks that its length equals the earlier stat size. If the file is a legitimate file smaller than the limit this works, but when called on a file from iconutil output the check relies on st_size from regular_stream; a file growing between stat and read raises a generic ValueError. More importantly, the ICNS sizing validation only checks framing, so a PNG-in-ICNS is never decoded before being copied unchanged on non-validated paths.
findings.suggestion: Keep the size check but give a distinct error for each condition; consider decoding the ICNS with iconutil, which is already done.

findings.title: Weak ICNS decode validation
findings.message: An ICNS can decode to an iconset containing only a few representations, or none that macOS actually uses. The check only confirms at least one PNG exists, so an icon lacking the 512/1024 representations passes. Also the test case 'structurally valid icns without images' catches either exception type, so it does not verify that this branch is exercised.
findings.suggestion: Also verify that the decoded PNGs are non-empty and valid PNG headers, and tighten the test to expect a specific error.

finding.title: Hardcoded personal absolute paths in committed artifact
finding.message: The committed report producer hardcodes a personal home directory and private workspace paths, leaking local environment details and making the script non-reproducible for others.
finding.suggestion: Parameterize paths through arguments or environment variables, or omit personal paths from the committed artifact.
